review: Wow, it's hard to believe that they powercrept Shi Don. Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Ryoshu or Heishou Ryoshu for short is an ID that utilizes Rupture and Haste to deal damage while also maintaining a neutral Rupture Count. Usually, Heishou Ryoshu is paired with Heishou Outis to make full use of their unique debuff, but she can also work independently. Heishou Ryoshu has a unique status that can be gained by using her Skill 3 or Defensive Skill, gaining 3 Strider [Mao] upon use. What it does is give 5 Haste next turn for a total of 3 turns which bumps up her speed range from 4-7 to 9-12 which is just a slap in the face for Cinq IDs. The downside is that you need 10+ Speed to make full use of her kit. So without another source of Haste, she has a 25% chance of not being able to utilize her kit.
